participation.context: Heard himself leave the roll, struck the direction out, and said the boy knew better.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Refused to weep before the cause, and gave the scene plain.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.context: Asked to hear it without the margin, and kept the boy unchanged.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Forgot to fidget, and kept his cue where it was.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: he makes the author hear the scene without the margin
relations.quote: Give it him without the margin, and let's hear.

story.body: You heard the plain farewell. You put the knife through the margin. You did not ask Nick to become a different queen. Gaunt this afternoon is a different death, and he is done by the middle.

relations.note: he makes the author hear the scene without the margin
relations.quote: Give it him without the margin, and let's hear.

title: Struck out the direction to weep

participation.context: Spoke in the passage after Gaunt's death, and did not go to the Rose.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You were already dead in the play. You did not restore the margin. You gave the evening to the jaw.
